3185.title: Claude fork loses compaction reference integrity
3185.rootCauseOneLine: The locked Claude SDK regenerates transcript entry UUIDs during fork but leaves compact-boundary UUID references pointing to the source session.
3185.proposedFix: Before resuming an SDK-created fork, remap compact-boundary UUID references from each copied entry's fork origin and leave unknown transcript shapes untouched.
3185.caveats: The malformed fork and reconstruction bypass were reproduced twice; no authenticated live provider turn was used to verify the reported event count.
